tools_helpful.evidence: Dev-agent loaded it on turn 0 and followed the scaffold + namespace rewrite workflow successfully, completing 5 scenarios with correct API mappings
Scaffolded project cleanly on first try, providing correct csproj structure for WinUI 3

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP PointerPoint has a PointerDevice property to get the device type; dev-agent initially copied that pattern after namespace rewrite
failed_apis.root_cause: In WinUI 3 (Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint), the PointerDevice property was removed — PointerDeviceType is available directly on PointerPoint

special_apis.special_handling: PointerDeviceType is a direct property, not accessed via .PointerDevice sub-object as in UWP's Windows.UI.Input.PointerPoint
Namespace moved from Windows.UI.Input to Microsoft.UI.Input; ProcessMoveEvents/ProcessDownEvent/ProcessUpEvent accept Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint (not Windows.UI.Input.PointerPoint)

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: 'Colors' does not exist in namespace 'Windows.UI'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Dev-agent initially wrote `Windows.UI.Colors` in Scenario 1 and Scenario 4 code-behind files instead of `Microsoft.UI.Colors`
errors_encountered.fix: Changed `using Windows.UI` references to `using Microsoft.UI` and used `Microsoft.UI.Colors` directly

errors_encountered.root_cause: Scenario 2 code still referenced `Windows.UI.Input.PointerPoint` type in local variables while event args provided `Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint`

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'PointerPoint' does not contain definition for 'PointerDevice'
errors_encountered.root_cause: WinUI 3's Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint removed the PointerDevice sub-property; PointerDeviceType is now a direct property

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with CS0234 (Windows.UI.Colors) and CS0029 (PointerPoint type mismatch) across 4 files
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Initial code generation used Windows.UI namespace for Colors and PointerPoint types despite skill listing the correct mappings
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent recognized the pattern, rewrote all affected using directives and type references in one pass
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill already covers this in namespace mapping table; dev-agent missed it on initial code generation (dev-agent-slip)

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS1061: PointerPoint.PointerDevice not found; XamlCompiler WMC9999 object reference error
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: PointerPoint.PointerDevice property doesn't exist in WinUI 3; the property was flattened to PointerPoint.PointerDeviceType
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent inspected the file, identified the API difference, replaced .PointerDevice.PointerDeviceType with .PointerDeviceType
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add PointerPoint.PointerDevice → PointerPoint.PointerDeviceType to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md API differences section
